summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe around the qualified nuclear fuel-cycle bottleneck, emphasizing HALEU enrichment and advanced fuel fabrication rather than generic uranium mining. The cleanest direct public exposure remains Centrus Energy for U.S. HALEU enrichment. BWX Technologies and newly public X-energy map to advanced fuel fabrication and TRISO/HALEU-linked manufacturing. ASP Isotopes is included only as a speculative shadow candidate because it claims future HALEU-related enrichment capability but evidence quality and commercialization readiness require much stricter verification. This Layer 1B pass expands the public-company universe around the nuclear fuel-cycle chokepoint, with emphasis on enrichment, HALEU, fabrication, measurement, safety, and qualified nuclear-service infrastructure rather than uranium mining alone. The highest-evidence public reference name remains Centrus Energy because of DOE-backed HALEU production and enrichment licensing. Underfollowed or second-order candidates include BWX Technologies for advanced nuclear fuel fabrication and nuclear-grade manufacturing, Mirion Technologies for radiation measurement and fuel-cycle/safeguards instrumentation, and ASP Isotopes as a speculative HALEU-enrichment technology option through Quantum Leap Energy. Claims are deliberately conservative: direct HALEU production claims are treated as facts only where supported by DOE/NRC/company sources; commercialization claims for early-stage enrichment or fuel technologies are labeled hypothesis or speculation.
